backend: Codex app-server direct; one fresh thread/trial
candidate_v1: 6000-character context for every task; later rejected because task-family latency regressed
candidate_v2: 6000-character context for simple one-file repairs/utilities; 18000 for interacting, async/concurrent, cross-file, ambiguous, or ambitious tasks; full closure workflow unchanged
candidate_v3: Simple-task direct coding fast route with no GoalPilot session; rejected after direct native comparison
native: Direct Codex on the same frozen task and initial repository
tasks: Existing synthetic Java range, Node async worker-pool, and Python dependency planner cases. Large-context cohort appends 32 unrelated Markdown notes (about 35 KB) to each repository. This deliberately isolates context-volume effects; it is not a sample of real customer repositories.
cache: Provider cache not controllable. Every trial retains input, cached input, output, raw total, uncached input+output, and wall time. Cache hit rates varied markedly; uncached tokens are the comparison metric. No subscription-quota conversion is claimed.
order: Sequential exploratory runs with some alternating arm order; no random assignment. Cache state, queueing and service load can vary.
judge: Independent case judge run after the model returned, with no feedback; all direct coding outputs judged against the same behavior oracle.
registered_gate: Promote only if completion is preserved, equal-family mean uncached tokens are lower than current and native, and equal-family mean time is no more than 3% slower than current. Raw tokens are descriptive only.
scope_limit: Three synthetic task families, uneven replicate counts, only one current/candidate/native matched run for Python and the refined Node full route. Not enough evidence for general/universal performance claims.

reasons: Candidate v2 mean uncached tokens were 6.32% lower than current but 31.24% higher than native across the three equal-weight synthetic task families.
The direct native fast-path experiment also remained materially above native uncached usage and had no GoalPilot closure receipt.
The screen is too small and cache/order variation too large to establish generally reduced quota.
decision.next: Keep 1.11 as stable. Do not claim that GoalPilot saves quota on simple tasks; use native Codex for bounded tasks and GoalPilot for broad goals where explicit closure criteria are valuable.
